Find and escort new recruits for the [[Kurzick]] army.

== Quest information ==
=== Objectives ===
* Find and enlist four recruits into the Kurzick army. [4...0] recruits remaining.
* Escort the recruits to [[Recruiter Sigmund]].
* See Recruiter Sigmund for your reward.

=== Reward ===
* 2,000 [[Experience]]
* 400 [[Kurzick Faction]]
* 150 [[Gold]]

== Walkthrough ==
The goal is to bring four recruits back to Recruiter Sigmund. You can bring recruits to him singly or in groups of up to four at a time. There are eight candidates available, but you may not recruit more than four at one time. If a recruit dies, you can use a replacement recruit from those remaining.

The candidates are scattered across the map. Although there is no map indicator for them, they are in the same locations every time. While recruits are following you, you can trigger Luxon [[pop-up]]s in various locations on the map.

The two biggest obstacles to completing the quest are the recruits themselves: they can get stuck on corners or objects. They also move very slowly and can get caught by patrols that your party has managed to otherwise avoid.

You must complete the quest before leaving the map to receive your reward.

I'm not complaining, but if you could go out into the foothills and help bring some of those eager recruits here, it would be a big help, yah."''

;Recruiter Sigmund
: ''"Good work, <character name>! I'll get these new recruits signed up and send them into training. It's a good thing you've done for the [[Kurzick]]s, today."''

== Notes ==
* The recruits can be used during [[Vanquisher|vanquishes]] or quests as non-renewable fodder.
* The Luxon equivalent is [[In the Army (Luxon)]].

{{bug|The quest can sometimes fail after a recruit dies, ''if'' the journal fails to update properly to acknowledge the loss — this prevents you from replacing them with one of the alternatives. There is no known work-around.}}

{{Anomaly|Despite the profession suggested by their names (e.g. Kurzick Elementalist Recruit), all the recruits are monks and carry swords.}}
{{Anomaly|The recruits have dialogue that appears to be in response to an encounter with Luxons. However, it can be triggered any time after they join your party.}}

== Trivia ==
* [[w:In the Army Now (song)|In the Army Now]] is a song by the rock band [[w:Status Quo|Status Quo]]; it is also the name of a [[w:In the Army Now (film)|movie]].
